subject_policy: generic reference values; individual measurements not required
tendon_elasticity: optional extension; rigid tendon accepted for first tension reference

hard: nonnegative active tension above imported passive floor
zero active force when native FLV gain is zero
solution_selection.soft: regularize total reference-normalized tension magnitude and its time derivative; computational selection, not a physiological minimum-effort claim

parameter_change_policy.mass_and_inertia: held fixed for these muscle-reference sensitivity cases
parameter_change_policy.geometry: held fixed; independent length/breadth/volume controls are a later task
parameter_change_policy.reference_force_scale: scales Fref, native active gain and passive force together; a PCSA/force-parameter sensitivity, not a rendered muscle enlargement or strength ceiling
parameter_change_policy.element_override_precedence: exact element multiplier replaces group multiplier
